_meta.purpose: Owner's 4-tier cost plan as structured intent: which agent belongs to which tier (heavy/vision/simple/verify). Read ONLY by LLMGateway.effective_routing_snapshot(); tiers without a reader would be a 14th shadow, so the reader + coverage lock ship in the same commit.

tiers.heavy: Frontier reasoning / psychodynamic inference. Served via cheapest capable channel (discounted Claude@Nous, Luna where chained).
tiers.vision: Photo/video/scene analysis. Must start vision-capable (Gemini-first intent).
tiers.simple: Hamaliye: extraction, classification, timestamps, traffic management. Free-tier intent (Groq/Cerebras/Nous-free where chained).
tiers.verify: Search-backed fact-checking (Tavily/SerpAPI/Exa wired via backend/api.py set_keys).

_meta.rule: New agent? Add its tier HERE (coverage test fails otherwise), then run scripts/generate_routing_shadows.py.
_meta.review_flags: passion_mapper + cognitive_profiler tiering is uncertain (extraction-vs-inference hybrids); currently heavy/simple split, downgrade/upgrade candidates. dialogue_manager/shadow_executor/interpreter are dormant (no gateway callers); tiers record intent for when callers land. lilith_growth is CLI-only (run_lilith.py).

human_behavior.note: Cold-reading inference over evidence (text path, no images).

cognitive_profiler.note: Profile inference. REVIEW: downgrade candidate if workload is extraction-heavy.

authenticity_auditor.note: Audit judgment; cheap-first chain escalates to claude.

shadow_executor.note: DORMANT: no gateway callers; evidence-gated execution intent.

osint_investigator.note: Synthesis over tool results; holds gateway but never queries (dormant chain).

vision_analyzer.note: Only task=vision caller with images; gemini-first chain.

autonomous_verifier_extract.note: Claim extraction; the ONLY task=fast caller.

dialogue_manager.note: DORMANT: no gateway callers; traffic-management intent.

interpreter.note: DORMANT in gateway (no callers); live path bypasses chains via interpreter_agent.py:37 hardcoded default (separate behavior-change round).

lilith_growth.note: CLI-only (run_lilith.py explicit model); bulk content generation = cost-sensitive intent.

pattern_interrupt.note: Short intervention generation; high-frequency cheap intent.

passion_mapper.note: Mapping/classification over scraped data. REVIEW: upgrade candidate if inference depth grows.
